result.summary: Adds explicit `#include <util/check.h>` across test, fuzz, and benchmark files containing assertion calls, and removes now-redundant `#include <cassert>` lines via scripted diff. It also allows `clang-format` to be invoked during scripted-diff verification in CI linting to sort the updated include blocks.
result.problem: Assertions in test files frequently rely on transitive includes or standard `<cassert>`, leading to ambiguity over assertion semantics (such as whether `NDEBUG` might disable checks) and hindering automated Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling.
evidence: Author description: "Avoid that confusion in test code with a scripted replacement to add the util/check.h include. The changes here will also make it easier to run IWYU."
Commit fa3b4b0e4a: "The project has a compile error when compiled without assertions in util/check.h. Thus, util/check.h should be included for all assertions."
result.scope_notes: A mechanical scripted diff affecting 153 test and fuzz files, accompanied by a small CI lint script adjustment.
result.changed_since_previous: The PR was taken out of draft status and rebased or regenerated across test files.
result.card: This pull request mechanically adds `#include <util/check.h>` across test, fuzz, and benchmark files using assertions, while removing redundant `<cassert>` includes. It addresses ambiguity around assertion semantics (such as `NDEBUG` behavior) and facilitates Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling. A minor CI linting update is included to permit `clang-format` in scripted diff verification. It is an internal test refactoring that does not affect runtime code or user-facing features.

risk.why: Touches only test and fuzz harnesses and CI lint scripts by adding headers, posing no risk to consensus, network, or node behavior.
